test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: For which of the following sources of financial resources may financial intermediation NOT be required?

options.text: Borrowing from All India Development Financial Institutions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Family funds**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Family funds** are financial resources that can be obtained directly from family members without the need for financial intermediation.
 
• In contrast, raising equity via public offering, borrowing from banks, and borrowing from All India Development Financial Institutions typically require the involvement of financial intermediaries.
 
• Financial intermediation involves institutions such as banks, investment funds, and development financial institutions that facilitate the channeling of funds from savers to borrowers.
 
• Using family funds can be advantageous as it may involve lower costs and fewer formalities compared to institutional financing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Financial intermediation** is a process by which financial institutions accept savings from individuals and lend them to others, facilitating the allocation of resources in the economy.
 
• Common financial intermediaries include **banks, credit unions, insurance companies, and investment firms**.
 
• Direct financing, such as using family funds, bypasses these intermediaries and can be a quicker way to secure necessary funds.
 
• However, relying solely on family funds may limit the amount of capital available compared to institutional sources.
